revisionNote: The verified main differs from runtimeCommit only by the handoff document. This report is also data/documentation only; its containing commit is not a new game-code revision.

implementation.confirmedDefect: When a selected hero bitmap or actual action atlas was pending, some native draw paths painted no hero body despite other decoded poses of that same hero being available. Lauren also had a direct renderer outside the final Ln boundary.
implementation.fix: Keep decoded original draws unchanged. While the requested asset is unavailable, select an already decoded nearest-direction bitmap belonging to the same hero and rebuild its actual render metadata. Preserve alpha and hit flags but do not inherit stale atlas crops. Restore the original action immediately when its image becomes ready.
implementation.lauren: The direct renderer now selects fallback image and its matching body/foot-anchor metadata together.
implementation.identitySafety: Never substitute another hero or an arbitrary effect. If all images for that hero are unavailable, no replacement body is fabricated; native loader and independent game/UI state remain intact.
implementation.loader: The existing bounded image retry loader remains authoritative. Requested cache entries are not overwritten by fallback images.
preserved: RC129 named phases, graze and STORY/DREAM
RC127 defense conversion and committed boss casts
